cases.description: A trailing comma omits the required second positional argument. VBE Compile rejects this as a syntax error.
cases.source:
Public Function InvoiceTotal(ByVal Subtotal As Currency, ByVal TaxRate As Double) As Currency
    InvoiceTotal = Subtotal + (Subtotal * TaxRate)
End Function

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total As Double
    Dim total2 As Double
    total = 100
    total2 = InvoiceTotal(total, )
End Sub

cases.description: A leading comma omits the required first positional argument. VBE Compile rejects this as Argument not optional.
cases.source:
Public Function InvoiceTotal(ByVal Subtotal As Currency, ByVal TaxRate As Double) As Currency
    InvoiceTotal = Subtotal + (Subtotal * TaxRate)
End Function

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total2 As Double
    total2 = InvoiceTotal(, 0.08)
End Sub

cases.description: A trailing comma omits an Optional argument. This is initially observe-only until the VBE oracle records behavior.
cases.source:
Public Function InvoiceTotal(ByVal Subtotal As Currency, Optional ByVal TaxRate As Double = 0.08) As Currency
    InvoiceTotal = Subtotal + (Subtotal * TaxRate)
End Function

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total As Double
    Dim total2 As Double
    total = 100
    total2 = InvoiceTotal(total, )
End Sub

cases.description: A bare local variable statement is rejected by VBE Compile as Expected Sub, Function, or Property.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim testStr As String
    testStr = "hello"
    testStr
End Sub

cases.description: A local String variable followed by an argument-looking string literal.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim testStr As String
    testStr = "hello"
    testStr "hello"
End Sub

cases.description: VBA can coerce a numeric literal into a String variable.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim testStr As String
    testStr = 123
End Sub

cases.description: A nonnumeric string literal assigned to a Double variable; this should guide warning severity rather than compile-equivalent error severity.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total As Double
    total = "blah"
End Sub

cases.description: A nonnumeric string literal passed to a Currency parameter; this should guide warning severity rather than compile-equivalent error severity.
cases.source:
Public Function InvoiceTotal(ByVal Subtotal As Currency, ByVal TaxRate As Double) As Currency
    InvoiceTotal = Subtotal + (Subtotal * TaxRate)
End Function

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total As Currency
    total = InvoiceTotal("blah", 0.08)
End Sub

cases.description: A string literal passed to an Object parameter; this calibrates whether object argument mismatches are compile-equivalent.
cases.source:
Public Sub NeedsObject(ByVal item As Object)
End Sub

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    NeedsObject "hello"
End Sub

Public Function InvoiceTotal(ByVal Subtotal As Currency, ByVal TaxRate As Double) As Currency
    InvoiceTotal = Subtotal + (Subtotal * TaxRate)
End Function

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total2 As Double
    total2 = InvoiceTotal(100, 0.08)
End Sub

cases.description: A function call used in an assignment expression without parentheses around arguments.
cases.source:
Public Function InvoiceTotal(ByVal Subtotal As Currency, ByVal TaxRate As Double) As Currency
    InvoiceTotal = Subtotal + (Subtotal * TaxRate)
End Function

Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Dim total As Double
    total = InvoiceTotal 100, 0.08
End Sub

cases.description: A Call statement with arguments but without the required parentheses.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Call MsgBox "hello"
End Sub

cases.description: A single-line If statement whose condition is not followed by Then.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    If 1 = 1
        MsgBox "hello"
    End If
End Sub

cases.description: A Case statement appears without an enclosing Select Case block.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Case 1
        MsgBox "hello"
End Sub

cases.description: A statement begins with member access syntax outside a With block.
Exit Do appears outside a Do loop.
cases.source:
Public Sub XlideOracleEntry()
    Exit Do
End Sub
